about.title: About Me
about.subtitle1: My name is Herihasina Michael RAKOTOARIVONY, a passionate Fullstack Developer with more than 3 years of experience in designing and developing modern web and mobile applications. I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and I am currently pursuing a Master’s degree at the National School of Computer Science (E.N.I) Madagascar.
about.subtitle2: I design and build scalable and high-performance applications, with a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and user experience. My goal is to transform ideas into reliable, efficient, and well-structured digital solutions.
about.subtitle3: Curious, detail-oriented, and solution-driven, I enjoy taking on new technical challenges and contributing to the creation of innovative products. I am currently open to professional opportunities, collaborations, and freelance projects.
